items.title: Power-hike intervals
items.how: Warm up 15 min easy on gentle terrain, under 150 bpm. 5 × 6 min power-hiking a steep grade (15% or more), hands on knees or poles, at 150 to 160 bpm: short quick steps, upright, arms working. Walk or jog down between. Run the rest of the day easy in zone 2.
items.detail: 5.0 mi, 1,600 ft up, 1,600 ft down, about 45 min, under 150 bpm.

items.title: Long day
items.how: Mostly zone 2, 140 to 150 bpm; power-hike the steep climbs so you stay under 150 bpm. Eat and drink from the first hour, the way you will on race day.
items.detail: 9.0 mi, 2,360 ft up, 2,360 ft down, about 75 min, under 150 bpm.

items.title: Fartlek
items.how: Warm up 15 min easy, under 150 bpm. 5 rounds of 2 min at zone 3, 160 to 167 bpm, 1 min at 172 bpm and up, over your AnT and 2 min easy, on rolling trail: let the hills set where the hard bits fall. Cool down 10 min easy.
items.detail: 5.0 mi, 560 ft up, 560 ft down, about 35 min.

items.title: Downhill durability
items.how: Climb to the top of a smooth, moderately steep trail in zone 2, 140 to 150 bpm. 5 × 3 to 5 min downhill: quick light steps under your hips, eyes ahead, controlled rather than fast; hike or jog back up in zone 2, 140 to 150 bpm. This builds the quads for long descents. Expect them sore for a day or two at first.
items.detail: 5.0 mi, 1,750 ft up, 1,750 ft down, about 45 min, under 150 bpm.

items.title: Fartlek
items.how: Warm up 15 min easy, under 150 bpm. 5 rounds of 2 min at zone 3, 160 to 167 bpm, 1 min at 172 bpm and up, over your AnT and 2 min easy, on rolling trail: let the hills set where the hard bits fall. Cool down 10 min easy.
items.detail: 5.0 mi, 610 ft up, 610 ft down, about 35 min.

items.title: Long day
items.how: Mostly zone 2, 140 to 150 bpm; power-hike the steep climbs so you stay under 150 bpm. Eat and drink from the first hour, the way you will on race day.
items.detail: 12.3 mi, 3,240 ft up, 3,240 ft down, about 100 min, under 150 bpm.

items.title: Recovery run + strength
items.how: Short and slow in zone 1, under 130 bpm, on the gentlest ground you have. Heavy legs: swap it for an easy bike or a walk. Then 25 min of strength: 3 rounds of 10 step-ups a leg, 10 split squats a leg, 10 single-leg deadlifts a leg, 15 slow step-downs off a box a leg (for the descents), 20 calf raises and a 45 s plank.
items.detail: 5.0 mi, 880 ft up, 880 ft down, about 35 min, under 150 bpm.
